description: Source code for request object pool management in the lighttpd web server, including request initialization, reset, release, and pooling functions.

methods.name: request_init_data
methods.description: Initializes request object data with connection and server info.

methods.name: request_reset
methods.description: Resets request object to default state.

methods.name: request_reset_ex
methods.description: Performs additional reset operations on request object.

methods.name: request_free_data
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for request object.

methods.name: request_pool_free
methods.description: Frees all request objects in the pool.

methods.name: request_release
methods.description: Releases a request object back to the pool.

methods.name: request_acquire
methods.description: Acquires a request object from the pool or creates a new one.
